subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: What permanent public contract and initial channel-support tier should OpenClaw adopt for one-submit multi-selection in message presentation?
rationale: The feature crosses the public plugin SDK and transports whose controls, limits, callback envelopes, and lifecycle models differ; implementation cannot safely choose those permanent semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Portable additive action
options.body: Add a typed multi-select action with aggregate callbacks, initial Discord and Slack rendering, and numbered-text fallback while deferring richer modal and Web App lifecycles.

options.title: General form API
options.body: Design a broader structured-input contract covering validation, multiple fields, multi-step state, and channel modal lifecycles before implementing this use case.

options.title: Channel-specific APIs
options.body: Keep the shared presentation contract scalar and expose native multi-select behavior only through individual channel plugin APIs.

recommendation.title: Portable additive action
recommendation.body: Add a typed multi-select action with aggregate callbacks, initial Discord and Slack rendering, and numbered-text fallback while deferring richer modal and Web App lifecycles.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history and prior review evidence connects this person to the shared presentation and SDK contract requiring the decision.
